subject.title: [Feature]:   Add configurable send hotkey for WebChat (Cmd+Enter instead of Enter)

question: Should the WebChat send-shortcut preference live in scoped browser UiSettings, gateway/openclaw.json config, or be declined in favor of the current Enter-to-send behavior?
rationale: The request is valid source-level UX friction, but adding a persisted shortcut setting or config surface is a product and compatibility choice under the repository policy.

options.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
options.body: Add a gateway-scoped browser preference, keep Enter-to-send as the default, route visible copy through i18n, and test Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence.

options.title: Add Gateway Config
options.body: Introduce a documented gateway/openclaw.json setting only if maintainers want operators to control the shortcut across browser clients.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Decline the preference and keep plain Enter as the only primary send shortcut, closing duplicate reports by product decision.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped UiSettings
recommendation.body: Add a gateway-scoped browser preference, keep Enter-to-send as the default, route visible copy through i18n, and test Enter, Shift+Enter, IME, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, and persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review and current-main ownership across WebChat, settings, and docs make this the clearest settings-scope decision owner.
